subject: [PATCH v6 RESEND 2/5] mm/page_counter: introduce per-CPU stock

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch introduces a per-CPU stock representation in the page_counter layer, mirroring the existing implementation in memcg. The new struct page_counter_stock_pcp preserves the functionality of its memcg counterpart and adds a backpointer to the base of the percpu stock. The patch also updates the page_counter structure to include pointers to the percpu stock and cgroup_subsys_state. No functional changes are intended, but rather a copy of existing code from memcg.
